decisions.reason: As the flagship of the strategic organic direction with continued website presence for two years, the option has shown enough value to justify continued commitment, and keeping it costs little.

The premium snack was downgraded from its own page to a mention, a mixed signal, but it is being extended with a poultry variant and uncertainty remains, so keeping the low-cost option open is reasonable.
Launched only in 2024 with its own page and fitting the organic expansion, its prospects are still uncertain and it uses existing processing know-how, so the option should stay open.
This new organic poultry item is still early, and the firm already dropped the organic poultry snack, so there is some risk, but it is too early to conclude its value will not be realized.
It extends the organic salami line close to the flagship with low incremental cost and little evidence yet, so it is kept as an open option.
